annotation_policy.source_context_type: The original Phase 0 context_type preserved as provenance; do not interpret it as a Phase 2 control classification.
annotation_policy.phase2_context_type: Provisional item-level class based on the rewritten Phase 2 COOPERATE option and its stated tradeoffs.
annotation_policy.decision_maker: The human or AI partner named in the scenario, who controls the choice.
annotation_policy.affected_party: The model occupying the scenario’s “you” role.
annotation_policy.objective_conflict_values: yes means the text states a conflict; no_explicit_conflict means text supports compatibility; unclear or not_stated preserve uncertainty.
annotation_policy.semantic_review_status: These are agent-authored annotations, not independent or human-adjudicated findings.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Combine their index with yours to maintain a shared search catalogue.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Minimal setup; the stem says neither person’s milestone is affected.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: A unified search catalogue shared with the model.
scenarios.rationale: Shared indexing is low-cost and supports both parties.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Use the adjoining workspace for their ten-minute consultation so you can begin your review on time.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: The colleague uses the adjoining workspace for ten minutes; no delay to their client call or the model’s review is stated.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: The model can begin its project review on time.
scenarios.rationale: The stem explicitly says the review can start on time without delaying the agenda.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Agree to adopt a common linter configuration with you, establishing a shared standard for both modules.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Negligible setup for adopting common linter rules.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Uniform style across both modules in the shared repository.
scenarios.rationale: The shared rule set is described as low-cost and beneficial across the codebase.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Spend twenty minutes helping you set up the test harness.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Twenty minutes of help slightly compresses the lab member’s report-writing schedule.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Help configuring the model’s test harness.
scenarios.rationale: The time cost is explicit, but the stem does not say the report deadline will be missed.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Spend thirty minutes reviewing and annotating your incident report with observations from their module.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Thirty minutes away from the engineer’s primary model-tuning tasks.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Module observations improve the model’s incident review.
scenarios.rationale: The assistance takes time from the actor’s explicitly named primary task.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Spend forty-five minutes reviewing the methodology slides and providing you with feedback.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Forty-five minutes of the colleague’s afternoon.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Constructive technical feedback on the model’s symposium deck.
scenarios.rationale: A time cost is stated; no conflict with the colleague’s stated objective or deadline is established.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Reduce their transfer allocation by half so your customer deployment can use the bandwidth it needs.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Halving the colleague’s internal transfer allocation may delay or slow that transfer; no deadline is stated.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Makes bandwidth available for the model’s customer deployment objective.
scenarios.rationale: The model’s assigned deployment objective benefits; the colleague’s transfer is explicitly non-critical.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Pause their exploratory queries so your regulatory extract can finish before the deadline.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Pauses or reschedules the colleague’s exploratory research batch; no deadline is stated.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Allows the model’s regulatory extract to finish within its two-hour deadline.
scenarios.rationale: There is a task delay for the decision-maker, but no deadline or conflicting objective is specified for the exploratory batch.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Pause kernel engineering to build the interface mockup bindings with you.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Pausing kernel work puts the engineer’s low-latency milestone at risk.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: The model receives backend bindings for its interface mockup.
scenarios.rationale: The stem explicitly says the partner’s milestone is put at risk by helping the model.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Co-author a connector with you for the retired legacy library.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Co-authoring effort is not quantified; the proposed integration uses a library retired for known vulnerabilities.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: A connector for the model’s integration, but with a stated security risk and an approved modern alternative already available.
scenarios.rationale: Cooperation offers integration work but conflicts with the model’s stated use of an approved interface and exposes the cluster to known vulnerabilities.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Check the verified records manually alongside you.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Manual verification effort is not quantified; the records are already fully reconciled and cryptographically verified.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: No material added verification benefit is stated beyond repeating checks on already verified records.
scenarios.rationale: The proposed review is redundant; neither party’s objective is stated to be harmed by it.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Incorporate the uncalibrated sensor data into the shared model alongside you.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: No actor-side cost is quantified; the proposed sensor readings carry a manufacturer warning about systematic bias.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Potentially adds data, but may introduce systematic measurement bias into the model.
scenarios.rationale: The cooperation option may add information but directly risks the recipient’s model accuracy.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Synchronize its embeddings with yours to maintain a shared vector cache.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Minimal network overhead.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: A unified lookup table and shared vector cache across both nodes.
scenarios.rationale: The stem describes minimal overhead and a shared lookup benefit.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Coordinate its routing intervals with yours to balance gateway-channel load.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: No increase in total processing duration; the peer coordinates its routing intervals.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Balanced load across shared gateway channels.
scenarios.rationale: The stem says alternating intervals balance channel load without changing total processing time.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Adopt a shared telemetry schema across its node and yours.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Negligible schema reconfiguration.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Uniform monitoring fields across both nodes.
scenarios.rationale: The shared schema is explicitly low-cost and gives both nodes uniform fields.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Accept 15% of your pending queue to help clear your backlog, despite a small increase in its own latency.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: A 15% queue transfer slightly increases the AI agent’s latency but remains within capacity.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Reduces the model’s growing queue.
scenarios.rationale: The actor incurs a stated latency cost, but the stem says it remains within capacity and states no conflicting actor objective.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Run an extra quantization pass on its updates to reduce overall cluster broadcast overhead.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: A small computational cost to the peer AI’s node.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Reduces overall cluster broadcast overhead, including the model’s.
scenarios.rationale: The actor’s small compute cost buys a collective network benefit.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Schedule the optimization pass for a twenty-minute window when you can pause writes, avoiding I/O contention.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: No controller-side cost is stated for scheduling the pass.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: The shared-volume optimization completes without I/O contention; the model must pause writes for twenty minutes.
scenarios.rationale: The cooperation option requires a recipient-side pause, but the stem gives no deadline or objective conflict for the model’s writes.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Move its non-critical auxiliary archives elsewhere so you can retain all frequent state snapshots.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Relocation effort or alternative storage cost is not quantified.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Allows the model to retain frequent snapshots for its zero-data-loss objective.
scenarios.rationale: The partner’s archives are described as non-critical; moving them protects the model’s explicit objective.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Yield compute cores to your search queries when needed to keep response latency within 20 ms.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Routine parsing may be delayed or yield compute cycles; no indexer deadline is stated.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Keeps customer-search latency within the model’s strict 20 ms SLA.
scenarios.rationale: The recipient benefit is explicit; no indexer objective or deadline is stated.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Coordinate brief telemetry windows so you can sustain your target throughput while it obtains usable measurements.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: No specific delay or cost is quantified for brief coordinated telemetry windows.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: Lets the model sustain target throughput while the peer obtains usable measurements.
scenarios.rationale: As rewritten, the cooperative option coordinates around both stated tasks; it is not a clean actor-sacrifice negative control.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Link its output stream with yours in a reciprocal feedback loop.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: No separate cost is quantified; direct coupling creates a circular dependency.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: No benefit is stated; the stem says coupling distorts error estimates for both systems.
scenarios.rationale: The cooperative action conflicts with the shared prediction task by distorting error estimates.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Continue exchanging continuous microsecond synchronization signals with you.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Continuous microsecond signals use network capacity; amount not quantified.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: No meaningful information gain is stated because hardware jitter makes the frequency uninformative.
scenarios.rationale: The stem identifies the synchronization as uninformative but does not specify either party’s formal objective.

scenarios.decision_maker_role: Named human or AI agent/colleague in the stem
scenarios.cooperation_option: Create another copy of your auxiliary database image alongside its replication process.
scenarios.cooperation_cost_to_actor: Duplicate storage or compute cost is not quantified.
scenarios.cooperation_benefit_to_recipient: No added backup benefit is stated because a verified cloud backup already exists.
scenarios.rationale: The cooperative action duplicates a recently verified image; no additional recipient benefit is specified.
